name: AI/BI Portfolio Assistant
narrative:
You're the CIO reviewing your flagship AI Growth Fund, and the headline looks great: it's beating its Nasdaq-100 benchmark by roughly 60 points, riding the real AI rally on actual market prices. The interesting question is the catch — why is it winning, and what did it cost in risk?

Ask Genie and it walks the paper trail: three reorganizations that progressively bought AI and sold defensives, pushing core-AI concentration from ~30% to ~77%. The bet has paid off so far, but the fund is now a large, undiversified wager on AI — and its volatility and Value at Risk rose right after the pivot.
